title: Overcoming Tight Constraints in Soft Happy Colouring
summary: The Soft Happy Colouring (SHC) problem, a mathematical framework for identifying homophilic network structures, seeks to maximise the number of $ρ$-happy vertices, i.e., vertices with at least a proportion $ρ$ of neighbours that share the same colour. Because this NP-hard problem makes finding exact solutions intractable for large networks, probabilistic metaheuristics such as the Cross-Entropy (CE) method are suitable candidates.
